tasks.analysis: Honeybee social structure is a fascinating example of cooperation and division of labor in the animal kingdom. The main role of the queen bee is to lay thousands of eggs to keep the colony growing. Worker bees are the busy multitaskers; they collect nectar and pollen, feed baby bees, clean the hive, and stand guard against intruders. The only job of the male drones is to mate with a queen from another hive.
